caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an iron trivet with a triangular base and three short legs. The trivet is rendered in shades of dark brown, with lighter and darker areas suggesting its metallic nature and surface wear. The handle extends from one corner of the triangle and features a twisted design forming a grip, ending in a loop. The background is a plain, cream or off-white color and unadorned, making the trivet stand out centrally within the composition. The overall style is detailed and realistic, focusing on the metallic texture and the structural features of the trivet.
title: Trivet
